title: A Study of Eloralintide (LY3841136) in Participants With Persistent Obesity Who Are Treated With a Weekly Incretin ( ENLIGHTEN-6 )
official: J3R-MC-YDAL - A Phase 3 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Once Weekly Eloralintide in Adult Participants With Persistent Obesity or Overweight Treated With a Weekly Incretin, With and Without Type 2 Diabetes
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate that eloralintide is superior to placebo for change in body weight.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Be on stable incretin therapy at screening
2. Have persistent obesity or overweight defined as: o	≥30 kg/m2 OR o	≥27 kg/m2 with at least one existing obesity related complication at screening: 	hypertension 	dyslipidemia 	obstructive sleep apnea 	cardiovascular disease, or 	type 2 diabetes
3. Have a stable body weight (<5% body weight change) at screening
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants must NOT:  Have had or are planning to have surgery, an endoscopic procedure, and/or device-based therapy for weight loss (with exceptions)
2. Participants must NOT: Have type 1 diabetes
3. Participants must NOT:  Have taken certain medications for blood sugar within 90 days prior to screening
4. Participants must NOT:  Have had a serious heart condition within 90 days prior to screening
